implementation.label: release-aligned supported subset with declared runtime/method deviations

T0: post correctness on new frozen Judge Base-wrong requests
generality: T1G/T2G/T3G/T4G primary Fix=sum((1-c0)*ct)/sum(1-c0); secondary PostAcc over all legitimate probes
OutputAgreement: separate normalized pre/post raw output agreement, never correctness
normalization: NFKC/casefold/whitespace only; preserve medical polarity/number content
PairCorrect: native_correct AND H_eval_correct, average within edit then edit macro; native failures remain in denominator

denominator.Base_mask: new uniform Judge on Base once BEFORE student output; freeze for all methods/prefixes
denominator.comparison: same task and exact common support, full cohort and H/G support separate
denominator.execution_failure: not a semantic false or dropped row; report completion, conditional metrics and intention-to-edit failures separately

aggregation.multiplicity: exploratory descriptive intervals; no confirmatory superiority claim
aggregation.order_uncertainty: one frozen order; bootstrap does not estimate order uncertainty

task_differences: release T1G perturbations vs paper same-semantic independent images: stratify and do not conflate
release generality PostAcc vs paper originally-wrong Fix: both reported, Fix primary
tasks may have distinct queues; no fabricated common N
no T5 permission and no ten-task Overall
no blind equivalence assumption for negation/numeric/uncertainty rewrites

Judge.version_claim: actual execution only; no fabricated service attestation
Judge.isolation: fresh isolated model context, no tools or methods/results/source-private files, complete visible batch only
Judge.retries: no semantic retries; format/isolation failures quarantined; any replacement requires declared permission
Judge.coverage: exact ordered IDs; reject duplicates, unknown/extra/missing IDs, extra keys and non-standard JSON
Judge.binding: full input/image/runtime/decode/reference/raw output/tokens/Judge config/execution lineage; never answer-string only

families: E_N full baseline flow; C_NO_H only if U covers all E_N
otherwise separate E_U common NO_H+baseline flow, not a slice of E_N outputs
sequence.prefixes: unique valid 1/50/100/N; evaluate all preceding requests and probes
sequence.teacher: frozen Base only, no future edit information
sequence.independent_expert_replay: require full state/input/support/init/seed binding; insert in order and regenerate all bank outputs; report replay cost
sequence.LoRA_GRACE: native continuous update/collision semantics; no stitching of independent single checkpoints
sequence.duplicate_conflicts: register all exact-input equivalence/conflicts from metadata BEFORE outputs; latest authorized native target defines active-target panel at prefix; retain original-target diagnostic and role-transition counts; no performance-based removal
sequence.role_overlap: now-edited locality ceases strict-Base role by predeclared prefix map, not post-hoc answer inspection; Base correctness masks remain frozen

input_roles.auxiliary_H_G_U: source-isolated from ENTIRE formal edit/probe queue and evaluation/held-out roles
input_roles.native_fit: only approved native-derived answer-preserving fit, no official T2G derivatives
